whoTheyAre.summary: This profile covers the specific Northern Kurdish (Kurmanji) PeopleGroups record in Türkiye. Broader Kurdish demographic and language context is used carefully and does not collapse Türkiye's diverse Kurdish communities into one homogeneous population.

religionAndCommunity.summary: PeopleGroups.org currently classifies this source record under Sunni Islam. Minority Rights Group also documents religious diversity among Kurds in Türkiye, so the provider category is not generalized to all Kurdish people.

profile.whyUnreachedIntro: The profile uses current provider mission-status and language-resource evidence. Kurdish identity, language history, political history or Islam is not treated as an inherent explanation for GSEC status.

whyUnreached.heading: Current mission-status evidence
whyUnreached.summary: PeopleGroups.org currently reports this Türkiye record below its evangelical threshold and notes concentrated church-planting activity in its GSEC label.

whyUnreached.heading: Northern Kurdish resources are documented
whyUnreached.summary: The provider lists Northern Kurdish Bible and film resources, separating media availability from the source's mission-status classification.

claims.text: PeopleGroups.org identifies PG024567 / PEID 24567 as Kurd, Northern (Kurmanji) in Türkiye with Kurdish, Northern (kmr) as the primary language; Minority Rights Group describes Kurds as Türkiye's largest ethnic and linguistic minority and identifies Kurmanci among the Kurdish varieties spoken there.
claims.interpretationNote: The broader Minority Rights Group profile describes Kurdish communities in Türkiye generally; this article remains attached only to the exact PG024567 source record.

claims.text: Minority Rights Group describes Kurdish communities as historically concentrated in eastern and southeastern Türkiye while also noting substantial migration to western urban areas and the use of Kurmanci alongside other Kurdish varieties.
claims.interpretationNote: This is broad geographic and linguistic context, not a claim that every member of this source record has the same migration history or language use.

claims.text: PeopleGroups.org currently classifies PG024567 under Sunni Islam, while Minority Rights Group notes that Kurdish communities in Türkiye include Sunni Muslims as well as significant Alevi populations.
claims.interpretationNote: The PeopleGroups religion label belongs to this exact record and must not be generalized to all Kurds in Türkiye.

claims.text: PeopleGroups.org currently labels PG024567 'Less than 2% Evangelical, Concentrated CP Activity.'
claims.interpretationNote: This is the provider's current mission-status label for this specific source record.

claims.text: The PeopleGroups.org profile lists Northern Kurdish Bible resources and multiple JESUS/Magdalena film resources in kmr varieties.
claims.interpretationNote: Listed resources do not establish distribution, comprehension, use, or translation completeness for every Kurmanji-speaking community.
